changelog: **Product tour in the page language (#2808):** both landing tours (internship and SaleVali) now serve captures and clips recorded in the visitor's language. English keeps its file names; Turkish and German use a `-tr` / `-de` suffix. `capture-landing-screenshots.mjs` takes `--locale=en|tr|de` and clicks and selects by stage key and testid instead of English labels, so the same script records every language.

en: The product tour on the home page now shows the screens in your language.
tr: Ana sayfadaki ürün turu artık ekranları senin dilinde gösteriyor.
de: Die Produkttour auf der Startseite zeigt die Bildschirme jetzt in deiner Sprache.
